theme.title: Mamba numbers
theme.subtitle: Kobe Bryant, 1996–2016
theme.recap: Kobe Bryant scored 81 in a night, 62 in three quarters and 40 or more nine games running.

questions.prompt: How many points did Kobe Bryant score against Toronto on January 22, 2006?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On January 22, 2006, Bryant scored a career-high 81 points

funFacts.text: The Lakers trailed Toronto by 14 points at halftime before Kobe took over.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Lakers trailed 63–49 at halftime

funFacts.text: Bryant poured in 55 points after halftime alone.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with 55 points in the second half

funFacts.text: He played 42 minutes and knocked down seven threes during the explosion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryant play 42 minutes, shooting 28-of-46 from the field, including 7-of-13 on three-pointers

questions.prompt: On January 7, 2003, Kobe Bryant set the NBA record for threes in a game. How many did he make?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He broke an NBA record for three-pointers on January 7, 2003, when he made 12 against the Seattle SuperSonics.

funFacts.text: The Lakers finished that season with a 50–32 record before losing to San Antonio in the playoffs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After finishing 50–32 in the regular season, the Lakers floundered in the playoffs

funFacts.text: Kobe was voted to both the All-NBA and All-Defensive First Teams that year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He was once again voted to both the All-NBA and All-Defensive First Teams

funFacts.text: Despite his scoring records, Bryant finished third in the league MVP voting that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: and came in third for the MVP award

questions.prompt: In February 2003, Kobe Bryant scored 40 or more in how many consecutive games?
questions.note: Nine straight, averaging 40.6 for the month.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: posting 40 or more points in nine consecutive games while averaging 40.6 in February

funFacts.text: Kobe averaged an astonishing 40.6 points per game during that February.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: while averaging 40.6 in February

funFacts.text: He also posted career-best averages of 6.9 rebounds and 5.9 assists during the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He also averaged career-high 6.9 rebounds, 5.9 assists, and 2.2 steals

funFacts.text: The Lakers' attempt at another title ended against the eventual champion San Antonio Spurs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: lost in the semifinals in six games to the eventual champions San Antonio Spurs

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant sat out the fourth quarter against Dallas on December 20, 2005. How many points did he have through three?
questions.note: 62, one more than the whole Mavericks team had at that point.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On December 20, 2005, Bryant scored 62 points in three quarters against the Dallas Mavericks

funFacts.text: Kobe had actually outscored the entire Dallas roster to that point, before the final quarter began.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: outscoring the Mavericks through three quarters by himself (62–61)

funFacts.text: Phil Jackson let Bryant sit out the last quarter because the game had become a rout.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Phil Jackson allowed Kobe to rest in the fourth quarter because the game was a blowout.

funFacts.text: Jeanie Buss later said she was frustrated Kobe hadn't played the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jeanie Buss, Jackson's girlfriend, owner's Jerry Buss daughter, and Lakers vice president of player personnel, was self-admittedly mad at Jackson

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant made just six field goals in Game 7 of the 2010 Finals. How many did he attempt?
questions.note: 6 for 24, though his 23 points led all scorers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryant, despite shooting 6 for 24 (25%) from the field, scored 10 of his game-high 23 points in the fourth quarter.

funFacts.text: The Lakers controlled the offensive glass and won the overall rebounding battle.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers had 23 offensive rebounds and out-rebounded the Celtics, 53–40.

funFacts.text: Pau Gasol pulled down 18 rebounds in the championship clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Gasol had 18 rebounds and Bryant added 15.

funFacts.text: Ron Artest chipped in 20 points, including a crucial late three-pointer.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Artest, who scored 20 points in Game 7 including his last-second three-pointer
